say:0:1120736001:0.text: It wasn't easy, but we finally found someone for the Bestial Brawl!
say:0:1120736001:0.source_cn: 虽然绕了一大圈，但总算找到愿意参加演祀的人了！

say:1:1120736002:0.text: Don't count your chicks before they hatch! There's no telling how the clan will react when Chak shows up!
say:1:1120736002:0.source_cn: 别高兴得太早啦。毕竟奇克他们是流沙之爪，恐怕族长不会轻...

say:2:1120736003:0.text: Let's check in with the clan and keep our paws crossed for Chak!
say:2:1120736003:0.source_cn: 我们先去和族长打声招呼吧，让奇克他们见机行事！
say:2:1120736003:0.male: Let's check in with the clan and keep our paws crossed for Chak!
say:2:1120736003:0.female: Let's check in with the clan and keep our paws crossed for Chak!
